proposals.after: Shiji rose to director-general of grain transport, and Shiyong became transport commissioner;
proposals.reason: 遭運 is a corruption of 漕運; the office is grain-transport administration, not a place-name governorship.

proposals.before: Nine attendants including Ma Yungiao, Tang Jinbao, and Zhu Zhaoyuan died with him, as did his wife Li, concubines Gu and Liu, two daughters, and Shiji's wife Dong and concubine Miao.
proposals.after: Nine attendants including Ma Yungao, Tang Jinbao, and Zhu Zhaoyuan died with him, as did his wife Li, concubines Gu and Liu, two daughters, and Shiji's wife Dong and concubine Miao.
proposals.reason: The Chinese personal name 雲皋 romanizes as Yungao; Yungiao is a typographical error.

proposals.before: Ben's banner troops had already taken Sangui's bribes and scattered in disorder, refusing orders.
proposals.after: Benshen's banner troops had already taken Sangui's bribes and scattered in disorder, refusing orders.
proposals.reason: 本標 refers to Li Benshen's command in context; “Ben” incorrectly treats 本 as a personal name.

proposals.before: Sangui asked that Wenkun also hold the Yunnan governorship, ordered all troops of the governor-general's command to Yunnan under his direction, and tried to buy him off, hoping to turn him to his cause.
proposals.after: Sangui asked that the Yunnan governor also hold the governor-general's seal, ordered all troops of the governor-general's command to Yunnan under his direction, and tried to buy them off with profit, hoping to turn them to his cause.
proposals.reason: The Chinese makes the Yunnan governor the holder of the governor-general's seal and makes the troops, not Wenkun, the target of inducement.

proposals.before: Southern Pacification General Aisin Gioro Shushuo was stationed at Ganzhou. Honglie wrote secretly that Yanling's wife Kong Sizhen, daughter of Prince Dingnan Wu Youde, still remembered the dynasty's favor and that Yanling could be won back.
proposals.after: Southern Pacification General Aisin Gioro Shushuo was stationed at Ganzhou. Honglie wrote secretly that Yanling's wife Kong Sizhen, daughter of Prince Dingnan Kong Youde, still remembered the dynasty's favor and that Yanling could be won back.
proposals.reason: 定南王有德 is Kong Youde (孔有德), father of Kong Sizhen; the English surname Wu is incorrect.

proposals.before: Southern Pacification General Aisin Gioro Shushuo was at Ganzhou; Honglie secretly wrote that Yanling's wife Kong Sizhen, daughter of Prince Dingnan Wu Youde, had not forgotten the state's grace and Yanling could be won over.
proposals.after: Southern Pacification General Aisin Gioro Shushuo was at Ganzhou; Honglie secretly wrote that Yanling's wife Kong Sizhen, daughter of Prince Dingnan Kong Youde, had not forgotten the state's grace and Yanling could be won over.
proposals.reason: 定南王有德 is Kong Youde (孔有德), father of Kong Sizhen; the English surname Wu is incorrect.

proposals.before: Men such as Chengmo facing Jingzhong and Xiongzhen facing Yanling lived in the same cities as their enemies and had no recourse but to die for their loyalty.
proposals.after: Men such as Chengmo facing Jingzhong and Xiongzhen facing Yanling lived in the same city as their enemies and had no recourse but to die for their loyalty.
proposals.reason: Chinese 同城 is singular 'same city'; idiomatic wrongly pluralizes to 'cities'.

proposals.before: Honglie raised his own army and broke with Mangyitu. Isolated, he was finally undone by Chengyin.
proposals.after: Honglie raised a separate force of his own and then lost contact with Mangyitu. Isolated, he was finally trapped by Chengyin.
proposals.reason: 異軍特起 means he rose as a separate force; 相失 means lost contact / became separated, not necessarily a deliberate break; 困於 is 'trapped by'.

decisions.reason: Wikisource transmits 世濟官至遭運總督; 遭運 is not a place name and is the standard graphic garble of 漕運總督 (director-general of grain transport). The original invents a nonexistent Zhaoyun governorship; the proposed office title is accurate.
Same as the idiomatic line: Wikisource has 遭運總督, a corrupt form of 漕運總督, not a Zhaoyun governorship. The proposed literal office title correctly restores grain-transport administration.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 世濟官至遭運總督，世永曆運使

decisions.reason: s0137 names 馬雲皋; 雲皋 romanizes as Yungao, so Yungiao is a typographical error. The proposed replacement corrects only that personal name.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 從者馬雲皋、唐進寶、諸兆元等九人同時死

decisions.reason: In context after 本深不之顧, 本標兵 means Benshen's own command troops, not a personal name Ben. The proposed literal correctly attributes the bribed, disorderly banner troops to Benshen.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 本標兵已受三桂餌，紛潰弗聽調

decisions.reason: s0025 has 以雲南巡撫兼督篆: Sangui asked that the Yunnan governor hold the governor-general's seal, not that Wenkun take the Yunnan post. 而以利啗之 has the 督標兵 as object, so the inducement targets the troops, not Wenkun. The proposed wording restores both points.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 三桂請以雲南巡撫兼督篆，令督標兵悉詣雲南受節度，而以利啗之，冀為己用

decisions.reason: s0159 names 延齡妻孔四貞，定南王有德女: the father is Kong Youde (孔有德), whose surname matches the daughter's 孔. Wu Youde invents the wrong surname; Kong Youde is the correct restoration.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 延齡妻孔四貞，定南王有德女

decisions.reason: Same kinship line as the idiomatic field: 定南王有德 is Kong Youde, father of Kong Sizhen. Replacing Wu with Kong corrects the invented surname without other changes.

皆同城逼處 covers two parallel pairs (Chengmo–Jingzhong and Xiongzhen–Yanling), each pressed in the same city as his rebel counterpart. Plural 'cities' is accurate distributive English, not a semantic error; forcing singular is stylistic.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 若承謨之於精忠，雄鎮之於延齡，皆同城逼處

decisions.reason: 異軍特起 is rising as a separate force; 與莽依圖相失 is losing contact/becoming separated, not a deliberate break; 困於承廕 is being trapped by Chengyin. The original 'broke with' and 'undone by' misread those verbs; the proposal restores them.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 弘烈異軍特起，又與莽依圖相失，勢孤，遂困於承廕

claimRetractions.reason: Accepted r0009 shows 困於承廕 is trapped by Chengyin, not defeated-by; that relation came only from the bad 'undone by' rendering, while trapped-by is already evidenced separately.
